description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewDecorator class, which provides a set of methods to manipulate PerformanceReview entities, such as setting employee and job title references, fetching reviewers based on group, and formatting date fields for display.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for PerformanceReview, providing utility methods to access and modify performance review data, and format dates for display.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a PerformanceReview instance.

methods.name: getPerformanceReview
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the encapsulated PerformanceReview object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee of the performance review by employee number.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the job title of the performance review by job title ID.

methods.name: getSupervisorReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer who belongs to the supervisor group.

methods.name: getEmployeeReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer who belongs to the employee group.

methods.name: getDueDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted due date of the performance review.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the review period.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the review period.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted completion date of the review.

methods.name: getStatusName
methods.description: Returns the textual representation of the review status.
